PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday FEBRUARY 9, 2017
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Eneix
Commissioner French, Velador, and Ward
4. Selection of Planning Commission Chair and Vice Chair
5. Review of Agenda
6. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
7. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
8. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of January 12, 2017
8
9. Public Hearings
9A. General Plan Amendment (GPA) 16-002, Zone Change (ZC) 16-002, and Zoning Ordinance Amendment (ZOA) 16-002
Palmdale Aerospace Academy, Applicant
General Plan Amendment 16-002 is a request to amend the General Plan Land Use designation on 15.99 acres from MFR (Multi-Family Residential 10.1-16 du/ac) to CC (Community Commercial); Zone Change 16-002 is a request to change the zone designation on 15.99 acres from R-3 (Multiple Residential) to C-3 (General Commercial); and Zoning Ordinance Amendment 16-002 is a request to amend the Palmdale Municipal Code to allow schools from kindergarten through grade 12 within the C-3 (General Commercial) zone subject to approval of a Conditional Use Permit for the area at the southwest corner of Palmdale Boulevard and 35th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-007 recommending the City Council approve General Plan Amendment 16-002, Zone Change 16-002, and Zoning Ordinance Amendment 16-002; and adopt the Negative Declaration prepared for the proposed project. Victor Mendez, Assistant Planner
9A
9B. Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) 74425 and Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 16-010
HRES Palmdale, LLC, Applicant
Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) 74425 is a request to subdivide 9.1 acres into two commercial lots and Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 16-010 is a request to develop a 24-hour convenience store with sales of alcohol, tobacco, gasoline, and an accessory automated car wash located at the northwest corner of Palmdale Boulevard and 40th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-008 approving Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) 74425 and Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 16-010 based on the findings within the draft Resolution and subject to the Conditions of Approval; adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring Program prepared for the project; and review the data and make a determination as to whether public convenience or necessity will be served by the sale of alcohol at the site. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9B
9C. Tentative Parcel Map (TPM) 73799
City of Palmdale Department of Public Works, Applicant
A request to subdivide 93.31 acres into two lots located on the southeast corner of Taintor Road and Division Street.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-009 approving Tentative Parcel Map 73799 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Matthew Alcuran, Assistant Planner
9C
9D. Tentative Tract Map (TTM) 60732 Time Extension
The Epic Companies, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension for the subdivision of 9.8 acres into 28 single-family lots located at the east side of 20th Street West, 660 feet south of Avenue P-8.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-006 approving Tentative Tract Map 60732 Time Extension and the reuse of the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for TTM 60732 on March 18, 2004. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
10. Staff Communications Development Updates
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
11. Planning Commission Communications
12. Adjournment to the Special Planning Commission Meeting of Thursday, March 9, 2017, at 7:00 p.m., in the City of Palmdale City Hall Council Chamber
